representation_fit.evidence: Brief demands monitor×volatile-evidence-stream (metric object, high time/density, traceable change). Initial screen is a 24-metric wall in 4 domain groups with per-tile sparkline+value+delta+status badge (screenshots/1280x860.png, 1440x900.png; source/data.js:44-94), a persistent inspector with 90-point trace, warn/crit threshold lines, hot anomaly segment and 12 timestamped point rows (source/index.html:63-72, source/app.js:284-320), and an anomaly event feed (index.html:76-79). Representation matches the shape bundle directly.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Anomaly detection dominates the initial screen: global counts 危急 2 / 告警 4 in the header, crit/warn tiles get colored left borders + tinted gradients and redrawn sparklines (styles.css:167-169,193-194), group headers carry 危急/告警 counts (both screenshots), the right rail opens pre-loaded on the most recent critical anomaly (app.js:443-444 '初始选中：最近一次异常事件对应的指标'), and the 8-row anomaly feed sits permanently beside the wall (index.html:77).

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: header states brand plus literal job subtitle '易变指标监控 · monitor × volatile-evidence-stream' (index.html:18), tiles are labeled 正常/告警/危急 with large 19px mono values (styles.css:185), LIVE heartbeat + clock signal stream liveness (index.html:22-26), and the inspector is already populated at load so what/where is conveyed without interaction (screenshots both viewports).

navigation_cost.evidence: Zero navigation to the primary object: the top anomaly's full trace is on screen at load via auto-select (app.js:443-444); any other metric is one click on its tile (app.js:66 select binding); feed rows click through to the offending metric (app.js:110-114); severity/group isolation is one click on header filters (index.html:28-34); Esc closes inspector (app.js:419-421). Single page, no routes or modes.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions preserve context: filtering dims tiles in place instead of removing them ('置灰保位，不做隐藏重排', app.js:329-341; styles.css:164), selection highlights the tile and updates a persistent side inspector without leaving the wall (app.js:323-327), inspector + feed are fixed panels of the same view (index.html:45-80). No modals, no route changes.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Permanent surfaces = header controls (3 severity + 5 group filter buttons, pause with Space, clock) + wall + inspector/feed rail; every one maps to the monitor job (index.html:13-40, 42-81). Density is high but the brief's shape demands many/high-density (brief.md facet table); no decorative chrome, one main screen as the delivery constraint requires.

accessibility.evidence: Sanitized receipt fails 4 of 7 checks: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size, type.min_projected_size (measurement-summary.json:13-16). Source shows real a11y intent (:focus-visible outlines styles.css:111-114, aria-pressed filters app.js:93, per-tile aria-label app.js:199, prefers-reduced-motion styles.css:283-286), but measured results fail across all a11y dimensions, consistent with very small type/targets (9.5px feed chips styles.css:268, 10px badges styles.css:175, 3px 9px filter buttons styles.css:86). Note: the package's own receipt script self-reports a11y.focus_order pass (scripts/build-receipt.js:76-93) while the sanitized summary records fail; the sanitized summary is treated as authoritative.

frontend_rework.evidence: Structural/layout checks all pass: layout.overflow, layout.responsive_collision, text.truncation (measurement-summary.json:10-12); both screenshots show clean reflow 3-col@1280 → 4-col@1440 with no overlap or clipping defects. But 4 error-level receipt failures (all a11y + min projected type, measurement-summary.json:13-16) imply real rework; plus a visible labeling defect: header '全部' count shows 18 (normal count) instead of the 24 total (app.js:210 sets c-all = METRICS.length − crit − warn; both screenshots show 全部 18 with 24 metrics in 4×6 group counts).

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed '指标变化可追溯，无闪烁噪声' is directly addressed: traceability via 90-point chart with threshold lines and highlighted anomaly segment, '异常自 05:21:07 起，已持续 0:11' computed by backtracking the status run (app.js:251-256, 272-282, visible in both screenshots), 12 timestamped per-point rows with deltas (app.js:307-320), and event feed derived by replaying the initial history so events match the trace (app.js:359-373). No-flicker via one-time DOM build + in-place textContent/attribute updates, tabular-nums, no animations (app.js:2-9, styles.css:2,183-185; only heartbeat animation exists and it respects reduced-motion).

defects_observed: a11y.contrast, a11y.focus_order, a11y.target_size and type.min_projected_size all fail in the sanitized receipt (measurement-summary.json:13-16)
Header '全部' badge shows 18 (count of normal metrics) rather than the 24-metric total, inconsistent with its label (app.js:210; visible in both screenshots)
Very small type/targets throughout: 9.5px event chips, 10px status badges, 10-11px mono deltas, 3px 9px filter-button padding (styles.css:268,175,187,86)
Internal inconsistency: scripts/build-receipt.js:76-93 self-reports a11y.focus_order pass while the sanitized measurement summary records it as fail; sanitized summary taken as authoritative
missing_evidence: Sanitized summary gives pass/fail only — no per-check detail on which elements/selectors failed contrast, focus order, or target size, so severity of the 4 failures cannot be graded
Only the two initial-page screenshots are available; post-interaction states (filter applied, pause, keyboard focus) are claimed in source but not directly visible
scores.overall_note: impl-06 is a strong, tightly-scoped fit for the monitor×volatile-evidence-stream cell: a single-screen 24-metric wall (4 domains × 6) whose anomalies are pre-computed at load, color-coded at a glance, and traceable through an auto-opened inspector with threshold lines, a highlighted anomaly segment, a duration-since readout, timestamped per-point deltas, and a click-through event feed (app.js:251-320, 359-373; screenshots both viewports). Representation fit, task salience, zero-step navigation, context preservation, and the acceptance seed (traceable change, no-flicker in-place updates) are all directly evidenced in source and on the initial screen. The weaknesses are measured, not structural: 4 of 7 receipt checks fail — all a11y checks plus minimum projected type size — consistent with the package's 9.5-11px chip/badge/delta type and compact control targets, and the header's '全部' counter mislabels the normal-count as a total (18 vs 24). Layout/responsive/truncation checks pass and both viewports render cleanly, so implied rework is localized to accessibility sizing rather than layout. The package's internal receipt script contradicting the sanitized summary on focus_order is recorded as an observed inconsistency; per rubric, the sanitized receipt is authoritative and task time, retrieval accuracy, and human preference remain not observable in this blind pilot.
